question.text: Given GBP/USD = 1.2650/1.2680 and USD/INR = 83.50/83.55, what is the bid rate for GBP/INR?

explanation.text: The Logic: GBP/INR bid = GBP/USD bid × USD/INR bid = 1.2650 × 83.50 = 105.6275. Mechanically: to derive the bid side of GBP/INR, sell GBP for USD at the GBP/USD bid, then sell USD for INR at the USD/INR bid. The Trap: Using the offer sides instead gives the GBP/INR offer: 1.2680 × 83.55 = 105.9434. The offer leg uses the offer sides of both quotes; mixing sides yields a wrong cross rate. Note: GBP/INR cross rates follow the same multiplicative logic as EUR/INR because USD is the quote currency in one pair and the base currency in the other.
